Resubmitted successfully.

**What changed in this iteration (to clear the "Customer convenience termination present" check):**

- The Company's convenience right is now a **standalone operative clause** (new §4.1A inserted after §4.1) rather than a sentence appended to the auto-renewal paragraph: *"The Company may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon ninety (90) days prior written notice to HDI specifying the Termination Date."* It stands on its own, is unconditional, and feeds the defined Termination Date used by the cap.
- §4.1 now carries only the surgical HDI proviso — *"provided that termination by HDI shall be effective only at the end of the then-current term"* — with the mutual 90-day notice retained verbatim (Vendor notice floor already met).
- §4.2(a) keeps its formula, with the ascertainable ceiling: *"provided that the Termination Payment shall not exceed the amounts payable to HDI under Section 3.1 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date."* The 4.2(b) zero floor and 4.2(c) quarterly instalments are untouched and remain consistent with a capped amount.

All four fallback elements are mapped exactly once; nothing was deleted and no extra boilerplate was added.
